title: A text box cannot be given room to spare down the box
goal: The Text section offers Top, Middle and Bottom for where the words sit down their box, and on a plain text box on the canvas none of them does anything, because the box is always exactly as tall as the words in it. Either give a person a way to make a text box taller than its words, or stop offering a choice that cannot bite.
notes: Found on 2026-09-06 while fixing where words sit down a box. Dragging the bottom edge of a text box MOVES the layer; dragging a corner re-wraps it and the height follows the words; H in Position & Size is not editable for text. Layer.resized honours a taller box only when fillingHeight is true, which GroupFlow passes for a child whose vertical placement is Stretch, so room today comes only from a container. See Scripts/playtest/words-down-the-box-walk.json, stage 3-middle-does-nothing, and TextBlockMetrics.topInset which is the rule that would then apply.
acceptance: A text box on the canvas can be made taller than the words in it, by a drag or by typing a height
With that room, pressing Middle moves the words to the middle of it and Bottom moves them to the floor
If the answer is instead that a text box always hugs, the Down row says why it is doing nothing rather than looking pressable
